note: The maintainer asked for this release to ship the dossier UI from 0.3.10 together with the dust and the final jack icon from main, after merging #335 (website and mobile app moved to their own repositories). The installer, setup, live research, follow-up, compare, stop, reconnect and upgrade journeys were not walked on this build; release_readiness.py is expected to refuse complete stable-readiness certification. The packaged build, the frozen sidecar's smoke check, the extracted portable copy's start and the catalogs were observed.

portable_start.evidence: Extracted kriko-0.3.11-win64-portable.zip; kriko.exe stayed up 22 s with its own kriko-sidecar.exe beside it and a responding window titled Kriko, then was stopped.

observed_instead: tools/gate.sh was run on this tree: node, ui and wheel passed. The Python leg had 23 failures: 5 IndexNow tests that checked a script #335 moved to the website repository (the test moved with it and passes there); 4 ledger/concurrency/trial/readiness tests that passed when re-run alone; and the agent-benchmark and failure-class tests, which fail identically on the previous main. The tauri leg failed only in kriko-harness locate_prefers_path_then_roots, which cannot create its folder under %TEMP% on this machine; that test and crate are unchanged by this release.

desktop.yml was dispatched on main and re-run; the windows job failed both times in the pre-packaging pytest step with different sets of sqlite 'database is locked' and concurrency-count failures (5 then 10 of about 5,100), so the release was built by hand with the documented recipe instead.
Version agreement is strict at 0.3.11 across pyproject.toml, kriko-ui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and kriko-ui/package.json; the website's links are moved in its own repository.

The full build recipe (kriko-ui/package.ps1 -Version 0.3.11) completed on this machine. The frozen sidecar's smoke check (handshake, health, lookup, job failure, MCP initialize, terminal) passed on a byte-identical copy of dist/kriko-engine outside the checkout, because this machine's sandbox refuses that binary its database from inside the checkout.
The portable archive was extracted and started: kriko.exe stayed up 22 seconds, responded with a window titled Kriko, and had its own kriko-sidecar.exe beside it.
